ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service Path Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service path modification via the "sc" binary to a suspicious command or path

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*binPath.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dllhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\Startup\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*")))
